name: Midnight Vows
source:
Lilith wakes up in a different world where her friends are vampire royals. What else awaits her in this new, exciting world?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
莉莉絲一覺醒來，發現自己身處另一個世界，朋友們竟都是吸血鬼王族。這個新鮮刺激的世界裡，還有什麼在等著她？
